story-context.title: Re-evaluate H2/H4 under rubric_v2
story-context.overview: AC10 passed under rubric_v2 with real judge variance. Re-run only the two plausible prompt-shrink candidates from Story 6.4.4: H2 consent/legal decision table and H4 operational-notes trim. Use the regenerated AC10 baseline as control. Ship only evidence-backed winners.

Exclude H1 and combined H1+H2+H4 from implementation and judging.
Use rubric_v2 and the Claude 4.7 + Grok 4 primary panel, with GPT-5 mini as control.
Revert losers before merge; a measured/no-change closeout is valid.
